verdict.rationale: Maritime is an agent hosting platform, so a code-execution capability is a fair question for it. However, the evidence shows no documented API for running Python, JavaScript or other runtimes and returning rich results such as outputs, charts or structured data. Hosting arbitrary Docker images, the Files API, and per-user Linux desktops (screenshot, mouse, keyboard) are adjacent capabilities, not a multi-runtime code-execution feature, so they earn no credit.
